title: SugarCraft — SugarPlugins
description: SugarPlugins: the generic plugin core for SugarCraft hosts — plugin and channel contracts, the launch context, the prompt-fence escape, and the trust-gated loader, quarantine ledger, registry and manifest reader. Original work; first-party.
ogDescription: The plugin layer a SugarCraft host builds on: contracts, a launch context, a loader that only runs trusted code, and a manifest reader, in one package with no dependency on any host.
tagline: generic plugin core — contracts, trust-gated loader, quarantine ledger, manifest reader
